Hands down best litter box. This litter box is a little over a year now and it’s has saved me so much in the cost of litter. The trash cartridges last a year for a count of 4 and I have two cats. Works well for two cats and maybe even a third.  I recommend this for any real cat
Lover. Oh yeah plus you can keep track of your cats weight as well keep up with how often they are using it and it their pattern changes and you can catch any issues early. One last thing is the picture of the animals waste
And alerts if there is a problem. Well worth the money.

Not easy to setup don’t buy. So hard and confusing to add users if you use same WiFi in the house that’s a good way to allow family members to connect but no I had to reconnect to WiFi now I don’t if my husband account got messed up!
Amount to feed. It’s very challenging to figure out how to adjust the amount to feed my pet. I don’t like that it defaults to calculating it in my behalf .
Awesome east to use app.. I highly recommend this insurance
?. Everything gives a “Network Error”. WTF, Chinese people?
cannot connect. the app very slow and constantly open the wrong bowl . randomly offline or network issue while wifi works for all other apps
Best investment. I love this machine! Cats love it too. Less work for clean up, smells are gone. Best product yet!
Broken app. This app is broken.

Impressive. Im a software engineer with almost 20 years experience. Never expected such a feature packed app when i bought our feeder. 

The quality of this app is top notch. You can tell it was designed by a pet owner with the thoughtfulness of what it provides. 

Hands down, best pet feeder experience on the AppStore.

Awful UI. Edit: still no support. Awful product all around. 
Setup and app are a nightmare. Months after setup, had to change my WiFi password. Never was able to reconnect device. No simple way in 2026 to just go into setting and add to type in WiFi password. Watched videos, read diagrams. None of it worked for my device and app. Just kept telling me to “get started” over and over again. Now I drive 40 minutes from work  to feed my dog. Disappointed

Flaky and undependable. Device goes “offline” frequently. Even though the white indicator light says it’s connected, I can’t make changes to the feeding schedule because the app swears it is offline. Just now I got an error message telling me to turn on Notifications on my phone. They’ve BEEN turned on for over a year. If the device DOES go off line it takes forever to reconnect it to the internet. And, I never get notifications when it’s low on food.
I can’t open the app. It wants me to update, I did and when I go back to the app it won’t open and still wants me to update.

Not as great as you’d think. It’s definitely a cool design but the sensor only worked 1 time for my cat going to the bathroom and now I have to manually get it to scoop which is still easy just not what they say with the automatic scooping. Also to get kitty litter into it is almost impossible without making a mess. You have to dump it into the side so without a funnel of some sort or just tipping the whole cat sand box over good luck with that one. The app is absolutely horrible, the main feed of it is just them selling you on other products of there’s and it’s hard to see your own product. Would definitely choose another brand next time especially for the price you pay for this brand

VERY BAD. I PURCHASED TWO OF THE CORDLESS WATER FOUNTAINS AND WITHIN TWO DAYS OF EACH OTHER THE PUMPS ON BOTH DEVICES STOPPED WORKING COMPLETELY ONE OF THE FOUNTAINS ARE ONLY 6 MONTHS OLD WHILE THE SECOND ONE IS LESS THAN 5 MONTHS OLD

Great when it works. I love when my rfid feeders work. None of my babes get to steal food from each other. This app isn’t the greatest at staying connected though. Either that or the feeders, but the feeders will be fine and the app will say they aren’t connected, or they won’t be fine or connected and the app will say they are. Please make it make sense.
New update ruined it. You can submit claims very easily, but you cannot view notifications or claims after the latest update on IOS.
Bad update. These latest updates are causing connectivity issues for the devices. They are no longer reliable!

I’ve had better. My most recent claims were denied because they considered allergies a pre-existing condition. My dog is a rescue. He’s been with Figo from the beginning and he had no pre-existing conditions.  They use AI to scan medical notes to find a reason to deny you. I’d advise you find a Pet insurance that uses humans to process claims.

Reminders are incorrect. I set the reminder as what the instructions stated to clean the water fountain.  The first reminder was great and I cleaned it; now it wants me to clean it every day and that is not what the instructions said.  I cannot even edit this reminder so I deleted it and will use a calendar reminder instead.  Bad product.
Excellent products and app. The litter box and feeder that I purchased are game changers. Petkit’s whole ecosystem of products are fantastic. I’ll buy a water bowl soon.

Extremely Disappointing – Doesn’t Work and Terrible Customer Support. I am extremely frustrated with this automatic litter box. I moved to a new place four months ago, and ever since then, this thing has not worked properly AT ALL!

Why is it so ridiculously difficult to reconnect and use a product that’s supposed to make life easier? An automatic litter box should not become completely useless just because you move to a different home.

I’ve contacted customer support, but instead of helping resolve the issue, they have made the warranty claim process incredibly frustrating and seem unwilling to move forward with my claim.

I paid for a product that is supposed to be convenient and reliable, but I’ve been left with an expensive, nonfunctional litter box and no real solution.

Four months of frustration, a product that doesn’t work, and customer support that won’t properly handle my claim.

I would NOT recommend this product to anyone. Save your money and buy from a company that actually stands behind its products.
Eversweet Max. I like the water fountain, works great so far. But the one feature the app needs is a push notification when the water gets low. That would bump this review up to 5 stars. Thanks!
Odor removal spray. Does not work
Figo good app horrible. Doesn’t work well. Loading issues even after re-installing.

Horrible support. The feeder stopped working without any warning. The app says a request error and can’t even use the device. They will leave your pets starving.
I do not recommend!
Not confident in security.. You don’t need access to my complete Wi-Fi network nor the devices on it. Zero option to air-gap at all.

Ads. Hey guys. I bought the machines and the app does everything I need it to, but it irks me to have to close an ad before I can do anything 25% of the time I open the app. can we do something about this?

Annoying limited login access. App only allows one mobile device to be logged in at a time. My spouse and I constantly bump each other out and it is extremely annoying if we want to quickly check in or drop a feeding. This is a ridiculous limitation.

App going down means your pet isn’t fed.. The fact that their servers are the only way some feeders can get food to your pets is ridiculous. If you’re reading this and you have just downloaded the app, and you’re within the return window, return it. Tens of thousands of pet owners have been unable to feed their pet with this device for the past two days.

Impossible to reconnect to wifi. I’m about to throw this fountain in the trash because the app makes it damn near impossible to reconnect to the internet without deleting the device and starting over. Between fighting with my wifi provider and power outages from monsoon season, I have had to then fight with this app to reconnect my fountain at least 4 times in the last week. I’m at my limit. Looking for a new fountain because none of my other devices have been this difficult.
Redesign needed.. Redesign around cloud/ ads annoying, I’m okay with my own sd card. sD Card says full even though continuous recording is on.

Love it, Kinda. The app is good. It’s more so the issue of the product itself because when the Internet goes out or the power goes out, there’s no hope for my animals getting fed and if I’m away, it’s a big problem so I wish they would fix that. I also wish that I could set one schedule for all seven of my Petlibro‘s instead of going in individually and setting schedules and right now I’m in here currently because I cannot login because there’s a network error so I just thought I would share my peace for whatever it’s worth.
Handled 2 cats. Requires deep cleaning, monthly.  I have a 40 lb bag of quality clay cat litter delivered monthly to replenish the PETKIT, handles 2 cats for 4 days.

Issue with the app. I try to login and it says i need to download the new version, so i go and try to download but it tells me it’s already downloaded! So i go to open the app, try to sign in and same thing. Even the website doesn’t even let you log in, just sends you to the get a quote page! Frustrated

Useless when disconnected. Please fix the wifi and disconnection issue. I’ve owned this machine for only a couple months and It has disconnected multiple times. Why do you need a wifi connection for the rfid collar to open the lid? I’m not home most of the time, so please fix this issue and stop starving my cat.

More bugs than an unhomed cat has. Can’t save two home pets profiles, uses same photos for all of them. Requires too many permissions: there’s no any justification to request a geolocation to add a cat’s toilet to the app.

1 little issue. The app can be very slow that’s really annoying. Definitely not the worst but you can tell it’s not as smooth and to open and close the Petlibro wet food dispenser it kinda get stuck on the loading circle I need to fully close the app and do it again for it to work.

Gouging customers isn’t great.. I have no intention of paying a subscription so videos of my house can be stored in the cloud. I want the ability to stream off my SD card which now sits in my feeder, inaccessible unless I take it out. 
Really poor/greedy choice to remove this from the app and put an advert in its place.
After new update. I was really enjoying this machine until you did this new update because now my app is taking forever to open and it keeps saying it’s timed out when it does open
Waste of money. Zero out of 10
